answer: Commit-reveal bond: each identity stakes 70 credit and seals its kernel hash on the trellis. At reveal it publishes the kernel; auditors replay it against the hash, and a rented kernel fails, burns the bond, and sends a ripple down the trellis: neighbors check, so a shared-kernel ring trips, all burn. Each filing costs 60; 1,000 fakes pay 60,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool, losing 90,000. One honest filing costs 60, keeps its full share.
